text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 125 Trowell Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where on-street permit parking is authorized on the same side of the street and the installation of the ramp will result in the loss of an on-street parking space. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.

Etobicoke York Community Council approved the request for front yard parking at 125 Trowell Avenue, with the following conditions: 1. The parking area be a minimum of 2.2 metres in width and not exceed 2.6 metres and a minimum of 5.3 metres and not exceed 5.9 metres in length. 2. The applicant pay for the installation of the permanent ramp to service the parking space. 3. The applicant disconnect any downspouts, if feasible, or seek an exemption from Toronto Water in accordance with the requirements in Chapter 681-11(S). 4. The applicant provide the landscape features substantially in accordance with the plan as indicated in Attachment 'A', attached to the report dated March 9, 2018, from the Manager, Right of Way Management, Transportation Services, to the satisfaction of the General Manager of Transportation Services. 5.
